policy: PFAS and lithium results are public-water-system or environmental-monitoring records unless a row is explicitly matched to a household sample. UCMR 5 is occurrence monitoring, not a compliance determination. Exceedances are computed only against the EPA final NPDWR maximum contaminant levels bundled in benchmarks and are labelled as system-level, never as a home-faucet test.

sources.name: EPA UCMR 5 Occurrence Data (Data Finder)
sources.reporting_threshold_note: This tracker isolates public-water-system detections at or above the UCMR 5 minimum reporting levels; PFOA/PFOS have a 4 ppt reference line.

sources.name: Florida DEP PFAS Program / Dynamic Plan
sources.tracks: Systems failing or meeting the EPA PFAS maximum contaminant levels across Florida counties
sources.role_note: Florida DEP manages PFAS monitoring records on EPA's behalf under the federal NPDWR; EPA conducts formal enforcement. DEP does not publish a single machine-readable PFAS compliance feed.

sources.name: EPA/USGS Water Quality Portal — PFAS characteristics (Seminole County)
sources.authority: U.S. EPA, USGS, and participating agencies
sources.notes: Nearby PFAS environmental monitoring. Not automatically a tap sample or a PWS compliance record.

sources.name: EWG PFAS Interactive Contamination Map
sources.notes: Cross-reference only. EWG aggregates community and public testing; indicators are leads/context and can never independently confirm a PWS compliance value.

reporting_note: Initial PFAS monitoring for all community and non-transient non-community systems is due by April 26, 2027.
